description: Use this when someone wants to compare mining projects' studies (PEA, PFS, FS) or NI 43-101 technical reports across companies: e.g. gold developers' NPVs, IRRs, capex or AISC side by side, or their resource estimates (type report). Give it a commodity (gold, copper…), a study type, both, or nothing. Returns the newest study of each company's project, newest first, each with its company, date, type, stage, price deck and headline figures (or a report's resource rows) copied as the release printed them with their basis and discount rate, and the 6ix.com link to the release; plus how many studies 6ix lists per commodity.

commodity.description: The study's main commodity as its price deck names it: gold, copper, silver, uranium…

type.description: PEA, pre-feasibility (pfs), feasibility (fs) or a filed NI 43-101 technical report (report)

name: compare_studies

caution.description: NI 43-101's cautionary statement: a PEA using Inferred resources, or a technical report's resources; quote it with the figures

effectiveDate.description: The estimate's effective date, as printed

field.description: npv, irr, payback, initialCapex, sustainingCapex, aisc, cashCost, mineLife, production, throughput, recovery, stripRatio, headGrade or fcf

period.description: The period the figure covers, as printed (life of mine, years 1–5…)

rate.description: The NPV's discount rate as printed

result.description: The figure in words, e.g. NPV C$1,856M (after-tax, 5%)

unit.description: Its unit as printed (C$M, %, US$/oz, years…)

firms.description: The firms the release says prepared it

flowsheet.description: The process flowsheet image the release prints (a web address)

latest.description: The newest study 6ix lists for this project

method.description: The mining and processing method, as printed

prices.description: The study's own price deck, as printed

project.description: The project as the company names it

qps.description: The qualified persons the release names

reportTitle.description: The technical report's own title, as printed

resources.description: A technical report's resource rows, each as the release printed it (deposit, category, tonnes, grade, contained metal); 6ix adds nothing up

category.description: Measured, Indicated, Inferred, Proven, Probable… as printed

sensitivities.description: The study's other sensitivity tables (grade, capex, opex, recovery…), row by row as printed

kind.description: price, grade, capex, opex, recovery, fx or other

anyOf.description: The study's own price sensitivity table, row by row as printed; 6ix works out nothing between rows

kind.description: price, grade, capex, opex, recovery, fx or other

stage.description: Announced (results released, report to follow) or Technical report filed

type.description: PEA, PFS, FS or Technical report (a filed NI 43-101 resource or property report: no economics)

total.description: Projects with a study 6ix lists, before narrowing

title: Compare mine studies
